row: Tony offers mobile medical massage using rockblades (IASTM), Avazzia biofeedback microcurrent, low to medium intensity pulse electromagnetic field therapy (PEMF), advanced orthopedic massage and cupping. These techniques help reduce pain and mobilize tissues to improve movement plus more. Tony is also a clinical exercise physiologist, PhD student, and is the lead paralysis recovery specialist for NextStep Atlanta Paralysis Recovery. Visit Www.massagepainaway.net or www.massagepemf.com to learn more or ask questions.
